mintAuthority.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper of yzUSD; local shares are bounded by deposited or bridged yzUSD, while each chain-local transparent proxy can have its wrapper logic replaced by its observed ProxyAdmin owner. Durable yzUSD mint authority is represented by the exact parent dependency rather than duplicated as a local issuer minter.

controls.label: syzUSD ERC-4626 staking vault (share accounting)
controls.evidence: On-chain review 2026-07-20 identifies this as the Plasma transparent-proxy ERC-4626 vault with asset() = yzUSD 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc. It mints/burns shares only against yzUSD deposits and cannot create base yzUSD supply.

controls.label: Yuzu Plasma ProxyAdmin owner Safe (4-of-5)
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 29275684 on 2026-08-08, the vault ProxyAdmin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0 still reported this 4-of-5 Safe as owner. Direct Safe reads returned version 1.4.1, the listed five owners, no enabled modules, zero guard and fallback handler, and master copy 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762. The Safe can replace the Plasma vault implementation without a separate on-chain delay.

controls.label: Yuzu Monad ProxyAdmin 12-hour timelock
controls.evidence: At Monad block 94284390 on 2026-08-08, the vault ProxyAdmin 0x7040b88de8a8e63b9dffe2250f8062dcc1ca7331 still returned this contract as owner, and getMinDelay() returned 43,200 seconds. Safe, Ownable, and module probes reverted, while the standard timelock delay selector succeeded. This immediate 12-hour TimelockController is the authority that can replace the Monad wrapper implementation.

review.evidence: syzUSD (variantOf yzusd-yuzu, variantKind strategy-vault) is a serial wrapper over yzUSD: the local share-accounting route cannot create durable parent supply, and yzUSD control is carried by the exact parent dependency. A duplicate local issuer-backend control was removed because it incorrectly made the wrapper look like a second issuer mint path. Fresh reads on 2026-08-08 reconfirmed the Plasma proxy implementation/admin and asset at block 29275787, classified its admin owner as a 4-of-5 Safe with no modules or guard at block 29275684, and reconfirmed the Monad proxy/admin at block 94284684. The previously unclassified Monad ProxyAdmin owner returned getMinDelay() = 43,200 seconds at block 94284390, identifying the immediate upgrade controller as a 12-hour timelock. Plasma vault owner() remains EOA 0xceaff57fbcd0e8f095c5c1125dd09b93fc5bbf82 and Monad owner() remains EOA 0x4ea00dc0c2b3933b9b41c6cc372832fe844a89ae; these operational owners do not create base yzUSD supply.
